cell_line.evidence: The genes encoding the full-length hPhK α-, β-, and γ-subunits, specifically PHKA1 (UniProt ID: P46020), PHKB (UniProt ID: Q93100), and PHKG1 (UniProt ID: Q16816), were cloned individually into the pCAG vector without any purification tags.

cell_type.evidence: hPhK was expressed in HEK293F cells by transfecting with 2.25 mg plasmid (Equal amount for each subunit) and 4.5 mg of linear polyethylenimine (PEI) for 1 liter cells when the cell density reached ~2.5 × 106 cells/ml.

disease_state.evidence: inferred: The hPhK proteins (1 μM) in both inactive and active states were premixed with GP at a molar ratio of 1:1.5 and cross-linked by 2 mM BS3 (bis[sulfosuccinimidyl] suberate; Thermo Scientific) at 25 °C for ~30 min.

material_type.evidence: Expression and purification of human PhK and GP in HEK293F cells

sample_source.evidence: hPhK was expressed in HEK293F cells by transfecting with 2.25 mg plasmid (Equal amount for each subunit) and 4.5 mg of linear polyethylenimine (PEI) for 1 liter cells when the cell density reached ~2.5 × 106 cells/ml.
